summary: Full E2E of PyTech Digital Next.js site via external preview URL. 11/11 backend pytest cases pass (services, admin login +/-, lead create+admin fetch, chat Gemini + session continuity, admin chat sessions, sitemap/robots, 404). Frontend E2E: homepage hero+globe+brand ticker render, all nav pages load (Services/Case Studies/Locations/AI Automation/Resources/Support all 200; Contact is intentionally /#contact anchor, not a route), lead-form multi-step wizard submits successfully and shows 'You're in' + 'within one business day' toast, Ada chatbot opens, replies contextually via Gemini, and maintains session across follow-up messages, admin /admin rejects wrong password with 'Incorrect password' and unlocks dashboard showing Leads & Conversations with tier scoring on correct password.

minor.issue: Root /api/ redirects 308->/api which 307->http://.../api/ causing a redirect loop over the public CDN. Non-blocking (health only), but should either not redirect or expose /api/health. All feature endpoints work.

action_items: Optional: fix /api/ trailing-slash redirect loop or add /api/health endpoint to make health checks probe-friendly.
critical_code_review_comments: Home page includes both hero WebGL globe and framer-motion; ensure lazy loading is preserved on production builds to avoid LCP regressions (currently 'next dev' only per package.json 'start' script — production start uses dev too; consider next build && next start for prod).
Admin uses password-only gate stored client-side after login; acceptable for internal but no rate limiting on /api/admin/login.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed leads (TEST_User, TEST_UI_User2) and Gemini chat sessions via API + UI
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 11 tests cover services, admin auth, leads CRUD, Gemini chat (real LLM, allow ~15s), chat sessions, sitemap/robots, 404. Chat request uses key 'sessionId' (not session_id) and response 'message'/'sessionId'. Lead form is a 3-step wizard (Step 1: name/email/phone/company inputs #name #email #phone #company; Step 2: service Choice buttons + budget buttons like '₹5L – ₹15L'; Step 3: timeline buttons like '1–3 months' + optional #message textarea; Submit button labelled 'Submit'). Admin login button labelled 'Unlock dashboard', input id=#pwd. The Contact nav link is intentionally an in-page anchor #contact — /contact route legitimately 404s.
